hints.title: Finite State Categorization
hints.text: Track the number of absences accumulated so far and the count of consecutive trailing late marks.

hints.title: Six-State System
hints.text: Only six states are needed: zero or one absence crossed with zero, one, or two consecutive trailing lates.

hints.title: State Transitions Modulo Constant
hints.text: For each step, append P (resets trailing lates to zero), A (increases absences from zero to one and resets trailing lates to zero), or L (increments trailing lates if under two). Sum all states modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear DP maintaining a 2x3 state table.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 3^N strings is impossible for N up to 100000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant 6 state variables transition in O(1) space per step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Model state using total absences (0 or 1) and consecutive trailing lates (0, 1, or 2).
